clips.title: The story
paras: Michael Garrett is a simple courier task linking trade in the Undercity with the Forsaken's flight network. After collecting supplies packed by Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter, you are directed to deliver the crate to the bat handler Michael Garrett to arrange aerial transport out toward the Sepulcher. It highlights how the Forsaken utilize trained vampire bats to connect their capital with outposts across Lordaeron.

Running a fledgeling kingdom carved out of the ruins of Lordaeron requires constant logistics. Outposts like the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest rely heavily on goods, munitions, and provisions moving out from the Undercity. Gordon Wendham packs the necessary field supplies into a single crate in the city's Trade Quarter, but carting freight by ground through blighted forests is both slow and vulnerable to ambush by Scourge remnants or wild beasts.

To bypass the dangers on the roads, the Forsaken rely on captive vampire bats bred and maintained by skilled handlers. Michael Garrett oversees these winged beasts from his roost in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Delivering the cargo to him ensures the supplies can be strapped to a bat and flown directly over the hills to Silverpine, teaching new couriers how the capital coordinates with remote settlements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate. If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.
Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett. He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
